h:
此 ComfyUI 工作流程专为 SDXL 修复任务而设计，利用了 Lora、ControlNet 和 IPAdapter 的强大功能。它将这些组件无缝地结合起来，以实现高质量的修复结果，同时在连续迭代中保持图像质量。值得注意的是，工作流程复制并粘贴蒙版修复输出，确保随着时间的推移将图像质量降到最低。


对于稳定级联版本，请检查此工作流程：
https://civitai.com/models/356167

为了获得更好的可读性，重要提示：在 Comfy 参数中将“线性”设置为“链接渲染模式”。

o.en:
This ComfyUI workflow is designed for SDXL inpainting tasks, leveraging the power of Lora, ControlNet, and IPAdapter. It seamlessly combines these components to achieve high-quality inpainting results while preserving image quality across successive iterations. Notably, the workflow copies and pastes a masked inpainting output, ensuring that image degradation is minimized over time.


For Stable Cascade version check this workflow :
https://civitai.com/models/356167

IMPORTANT FOR BETTER READABILITY : Set "Linear" as "Link Render Mode" in Comfy parameters.
